recommendations.description: Hold UM-rule and reimbursement changes until a claims-processing reconciliation, starting in TX and then VA, OH, and KY, validates AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION, PA-to-claim matching, denial enforcement, manual-adjudication overrides, and Not Mapped facility assignment for BEN TAUB HOSPITAL, CLEVELAND CLINIC MERCY HOSPITAL, CHRIST HOSPITAL, and METROHEALTH MEDICAL CTR.
evidence: TX AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION is flagged for validation before action.
Not Mapped facility buckets appear in TX, OH, and KY.
BEN TAUB HOSPITAL anchors the TX authorization validation drill.
VA Aftercare Musculoskeletal with MCC shows AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION movement.
Other Digestive System Diagnoses with MCC and Red Blood Cell Disorders are impacted.
CHRIST HOSPITAL and METROHEALTH MEDICAL CTR appear in unmapped segments.

recommendations.description: Implement a TX SNP acute inpatient prior-authorization and readmission control policy for DSNP HMO and CSNP HMO: perform member-level repeat-admission review, trigger CTI discharge planning for same-facility returns, audit CUMG nurse and MD approval-denial pathways, and require prior-auth-to-claim match validation with denial enforcement.
evidence: TX DSNP HMO acute hospital spend rose +$74.1M with 3,589 more admissions.
TX CSNP HMO acute hospital spend rose +$9.6M with 437 more admissions.
Paid per admit fell in both products, indicating utilization not pricing.
Both source cards require prior auth and show repeated delta concentration.

recommendations.description: Implement a targeted inpatient management review for Concomitant Left Atrial Appendage Closure and Cardiac Ablation in Medicare HMO acute hospitals across OH, IN, and NY, limited to PAROXYSMAL ATRIAL FIBRILLATION and OTHR PERSISTENT ATRIAL FIBRILLATION, with PA-required authorization enforcement, auth-to-claim and claims-processing audits, and provider-specific contract and site-of-care review for ADVOCATE SOUTH SUBURBAN HOSPITAL and other concentrated facilities.
evidence: OH added about +$5.2M with 94 more admissions across two AF diagnoses.
OH Medicare HMO acute hospital spend rose about +$3.1M on 61 admissions.
IN added about +$1.3M and NY about +$1.2M for the procedure.
PA required equals Y on operational cards in OH, IN, and NY.
ADVOCATE SOUTH SUBURBAN HOSPITAL recurs as a concentration point in OH and IN.
Paid per admit increased in OH, IN, and NY acute hospital episodes.

recommendations.description: For TX DSNP HMO acute hospital claims at BEN TAUB HOSPITAL tied to Red Blood Cell Disorders without MCC and Other Digestive System Diagnoses with MCC, especially HB-SS DISEASE WITH CRISIS UNS, ACUTE POSTHEMORRHAGIC ANEMIA, OTH POSTPROC COMP D/O DIGESTIVE SYS, and GASTROSTOMY MALFUNCTION, confirm required prior authorization, apply denial edits when authorization is missing, and screen complication claims for HAC or never-event recovery.
evidence: HB-SS DISEASE WITH CRISIS UNS appears under Red Blood Cell Disorders without MCC.
ACUTE POSTHEMORRHAGIC ANEMIA is listed as a key driver code.
OTH POSTPROC COMP D/O DIGESTIVE SYS and GASTROSTOMY MALFUNCTION are key digestive drivers.
Operational cards show pa_required_code = Y and auth_dimension_present.
BEN TAUB HOSPITAL is the rendering provider in the driving episodes.
peer_benchmarking: Elevance Health (internal) shows inpatient readmission bundling in the summary table.
Humana shows no readmission bundling in the summary table.

recommendations.description: Open a CHRIST HOSPITAL OH acute hospital reimbursement review across Medicare HMO, PPO Regional, and DSNP HMO to confirm contract-compliant payment methodology, authorization-to-claim matching, case-rate changes, and recurring edits or recovery for unbundling, DRG upcoding, outlier billing, and itemized bill exceptions.
evidence: OH Medicare HMO at CHRIST HOSPITAL added about +$1.1M with 50 fewer admissions.
OH PPO Regional had 2 fewer admissions with about +$14.8K higher paid per admit.
OH DSNP HMO had 15 fewer admissions and about +$2.7K higher paid per admit.
All source cards show PA required equals Y and unit_cost_led.
peer_benchmarking: Humana is Generally Denied; general authorization applies, and co-surgeon necessity must be documented.

recommendations.description: Review VA prior-authorization and utilization-management policy for Physical Rehab and Acute Hospital aftercare tied to ENC FOR OTHER ORTHOPEDIC AFTERCARE and ENC ORTHOPED AFTERCARE FLW SURG AMP across Medicare HMO and DSNP HMO; audit initial and concurrent review KPIs, confirm required authorizations were obtained and matched the billed site of care, route authorization mismatches to claims processing, and evaluate alternate discharge-location leakage and P.A.V. opportunities.
evidence: Orthopedic aftercare and post-amputation aftercare diagnoses drive the VA pattern.
Pattern is concentrated in Physical Rehab and Acute Hospital aftercare.
Medicare HMO Physical Rehab shows mixed volume and unit-cost pressure.
DSNP HMO Physical Rehab is primarily volume-led.
Major operational cards are marked pa_required_code Y.

recommendations.description: Route isolated ENC AFTERCARE FLW LUNG TRANSPLANT, ENC AFTERCARE FLW MX ORGN TRANSPL, DISSECTION OF ASCENDING AORTA, Coronary Bypass without Cardiac Catheterization with MCC, and Amputation for Circulatory System Disorders Except Upper Limb and Toe with MCC admissions at Houston Methodist Hospital, Valleywise Health Medical Center, and MetroHealth Medical CTR to individual case management for contractual claims review, final-claim adjudication verification, and interim-claim zero-balance reconciliation.
evidence: Single lung transplant aftercare admission at Houston Methodist Hospital added about +$0.4M.
Multi-organ transplant aftercare added about +$0.1M.
Ascending aortic dissection case at Valleywise Health Medical Center added about +$0.1M.
MetroHealth Medical CTR had one coronary bypass episode in OH.
MetroHealth Medical CTR had one amputation episode for diabetic gangrene in OH.
peer_benchmarking: Healthfirst time-based reimbursement applies only to anesthesia CPT 00100-01999, 99100-99140, and G0500.
Regence_BCBS does not reimburse preventable adverse events or related same/subsequent stay services.

recommendations.description: Implement a market-level policy review in TX, VA, NJ, and KY for PA-required Acute Hospital, Physical Rehab, and LONG TERM CARE HOSPITAL admissions to perform auth-to-claim validation, enforce denial edits, and review provider and post-acute routing for Aftercare with CC/MCC, Red Blood Cell Disorders without MCC, and Other Digestive System Diagnoses with MCC, including HOUSTON METHODIST HOSPITAL and CHRIST HOSPITAL.
evidence: Authorization-related increases recur across Acute Hospital, Physical Rehab, and LONG TERM CARE HOSPITAL.
Key driver codes include digestive, red blood cell, and aftercare DRGs.
TX Aftercare with CC/MCC and VA or NJ red blood cell pockets recur.
Source cards are tagged auth-to-claim validation and repeated delta concentration.
Recommended next step assigns segments to local UM and network teams.
Pattern requires targeted case-level confirmation before broad action.
peer_benchmarking: Humana summary states no prior authorization requirement stated.
